title: Zn(II)-based metal–organic frameworks with tailored architectures: optimizing fluorescence performance for cell imaging and cancer therapy

Two Zn(II)-based metal–organic frameworks, which exhibit significant differences in framework architecture, photophysical performance, and biological performance, can be utilized as optical imaging probes for cancer cells.
